summary: 60-year-old local woman Jan Parker died while skiing near the Friends Hut with a group of friends on Tuesday, March 12; CBSAR notified 10:29 a.m., CareFlight 3 helicopter from Rifle on scene near East Brush Creek 11:22 a.m.; extended resuscitative efforts unsuccessful; patient flown to Gunnison Airport and transferred to the coroner; rest of party skied out and were picked up by CBSAR
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue (CBSAR); CareFlight 3
notes: run-757 insert (Gunnison County SAR archives chunk); parent-opened and weekday-verified (Tue 2024-03-12).
